name: NudgeSells – Inline Upsells & Cross-sells for WooCommerce
author: Dons Digital

sections.description:
The best upsells don’t feel like upsells. They feel like helpful recommendations.

NudgeSells helps WooCommerce store owners increase average order value by displaying relevant product recommendations and add-ons directly on product pages.

Instead of interrupting customers with aggressive sales tactics, NudgeSells helps shoppers discover products they genuinely need.

Whether you’re recommending accessories, creating product bundles, or rewarding larger purchases with discounts, NudgeSells makes it easy to create offers your customers will appreciate.

Perfect for:

  • Fashion stores
  • Electronics
  • Coffee & food stores
  • Beauty & skincare
  • Home & furniture
  • Pet stores
  • Hobby & craft shops
  • Any WooCommerce store looking to increase average order value

View demos

Free Features

  • Display simple WooCommerce products
  • Display variable WooCommerce products
  • Fixed discounts
  • Percentage discounts
  • Checkbox add-ons
  • Quantity stepper add-ons
  • List and card layouts
  • Automatic fallback to WooCommerce Cross-sells
  • Display offers on all or selected products
  • Custom headings and descriptions
  • Custom icons
  • Read more links
  • Full color customization
  • Border radius controls
  • Thumbnail size controls
  • Product link behavior
  • Savings badges
  • Multi-currency support
  • WPML compatible
  • Polylang compatible
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatible
  • Revenue dashboard
  • Savings dashboard

Explore features

Pro Features

Unlock even smarter recommendations with NudgeSells Pro.

  • Bundle discounts
  • Tiered quantity discounts
  • Visual progress indicators
  • Upgrade offers
  • Customer role targeting
  • Scheduled campaigns
  • Minimum quantity requirements
  • WooCommerce subscriptions support
  • Flash sale countdown timers
  • Advanced analytics
  • New offer suggestions (for store owners)
  • CSV import/export
  • A/B testing

Compare plans

Why NudgeSells?

Many upsell plugins focus on selling more. NudgeSells focuses on helping customers buy better.

By showing relevant recommendations at the right moment, your customers discover products that naturally complement what they’re already purchasing.

Better recommendations create:

  • Higher average order value
  • Better customer experience
  • More relevant offers
  • Increased revenue

The upsell that feels like good advice.

About us
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate NudgeSells.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Open NudgeSells → Offers.
  5. Create your first recommendation.
  6. Publish and start increasing your average order value.
sections.faq:
Does NudgeSells require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I recommend variable products?

Yes. Both simple and variable WooCommerce products are supported.

Can I create bundles?

Basic product recommendations are available in the free version. Advanced bundle discounts are available in Pro.

Does it support WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Subscription support is available in NudgeSells Pro.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes.

Does it support WPML?

Yes.

Does it support Polylang?

Yes.

Can I customize the appearance?

Totally! You can customize colors, borders, headings, icons, images, layouts, and more. The font will be inherited from your active theme.

Does it support multiple currencies?

Yes.
